Legal Information

Acceptable Use Policy Last Updated

Effective Date

May 26, 2026

1. Prohibited Activities

Customers may not use Sterrocloud infrastructure for illegal operations, malicious software distribution, phishing campaigns, unauthorized access attempts, cryptocurrency mining, spam distribution, fraudulent activity, or any operation that violates applicable laws or infrastructure policies.

2. Network Abuse

Distributed denial-of-service attacks, network flooding, port scanning, packet manipulation, amplification attacks, infrastructure probing, and disruptive networking behavior are strictly prohibited across all services.

3. Malware & Exploitation

Hosting or distributing malware, ransomware, trojans, spyware, exploit kits, botnets, unauthorized remote-access tools, or malicious payloads intended to compromise systems or infrastructure is prohibited.

4. Resource Abuse

Excessive resource consumption, abusive workloads, infrastructure overutilization, unauthorized benchmarking, automated stress testing, and activities negatively impacting shared infrastructure stability may result in service restrictions or suspension.

5. Fraudulent Activity

Fraudulent transactions, payment abuse, identity misuse, account impersonation, fake registrations, chargeback fraud, and deceptive operational behavior are prohibited and may result in immediate service termination.

6. Infrastructure Security

Customers are responsible for securing applications, credentials, authentication systems, hosted content, and deployed workloads. Infrastructure vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, or insecure deployments remain the responsibility of the service owner.

7. Enforcement Actions

Sterrocloud reserves the right to suspend, restrict, investigate, rate-limit, or terminate services associated with abuse, prohibited activity, infrastructure misuse, or operational threats without prior notice when necessary for platform protection.

8. Reporting Abuse

Abuse reports, security concerns, phishing complaints, malware reports, or infrastructure misuse notifications may be submitted through official Sterrocloud communication channels listed on the Contact page.
